name: marshallcam
description: Self-hosted two-way video intercom for a TV kiosk (LiveKit + macOS)

scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client-max run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix client-max run typecheck
scripts.lint:sh: if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck -x scripts/*.sh scripts/macos/*.sh; else echo 'shellcheck not installed; skipping'; fi

author: baney75
